propositions: Preview and legacy --mode dry-run passes (documented as no-write) perform remote Jira add_label and set_entity_property calls during pending-binding recovery due to an unguarded recovery gate in run_differs._run_differs_outbound.

The recovery gate at run_differs.py line 420 checks only `if not scoped_ids:` with no persist/no-write condition, unlike the sibling invariant-filing gate which composes both axes as `skip_invariant_filing = (not persist) or bool(scoped_ids)`.

On a no-write pass (persist=False) with empty scoped_ids, the recovery gate evaluates true and calls binding_recovery.recover_pending_bindings(), which issues real remote mutations that are never persisted locally, creating an unrecoverable state.

The fix requires adding `ctx.persist and` to the recovery gate condition to suppress remote writes on no-write passes while preserving live-pass recovery behavior and the keyed-pending binding no-search rule.
